variables_used.HEART_Pathway: History, Age, Risk factors, Troponin (0, 3 h)
variables_used.EDACS: Age, Sex, Risk factors, History, Troponin (0, 2 h)
variables_used.ADAPT_mADAPT: TIMI score 0-1, No ischemic ECG changes, Troponin (0, 2 h)
variables_used.NOTR: Age, Risk factors, Previous AMI or CAD, Troponin (0, 2 h)
variables_used.2016_ESC_GRACE: History, Age, SBP, Serum Cr, Cardiac arrest, ECG, Cardiac biomarker, Killip class

low_risk: HEART score <3, Neg 0, 3-h cTn, Neg 0, 2-h hs-cTn
EDACS score <16, Neg 0, 2 h hs-cTn, No ischemic ECG
TIMI score 0 (or <1 for mADAPT), Neg 0, 2-h cTn or hs-cTn, No ischemic ECG
Age <50 y, <3 risk factors, Previous AMI or CAD, Neg cTn or hs-cTn (0, 2 h)
Initial hs-cTn is 'very low' and sx onset >3 h ago
Initial hs-cTn 'low' and 1- or 2-h hs-cTn Δ is 'low'
intermediate_risk: Initial hs-cTn is between 'low' and 'high', and/or 1- or 2-h hs-cTn Δ is between low and high thresholds
high_risk: Initial hs-cTn is 'high' or 1- or 2-h hs-cTn Δ is high
TO hs-cTn >52 ng/L or Δ 1 h >5 ng/L

performance.ED_discharge: 40% versus 18% discharged, 30-d objective testing by 12% (69% versus 57%), Length of stay by 12 h (9.9 versus 21.9 h)
performance.MACE_sensitivity: 100% 28% eligible for ED discharge, 62% Ruled out (20.2% 30-d MACE), 25% Observe 13% Rule in
performance.AMI_sensitivity: 100% for HEART Pathway, EDACS, ADAPT, NOTR, >99.9% for 2020 ESC hs-cTn, 96.7% for 2016 ESC GRACE
